text: Implemented PatchSamplePlan3 and frozen objective identities. World cells are deterministically partitioned into optimization/selection/audit roles; cells are disjoint, while cross-boundary stencil dependence is explicitly recorded and supportsGeneralizationClaim=false. Each role uses seeded with-replacement draws with p=lambda/N+(1-lambda)q/Q, normalized to floating-point unity, a strictly positive uniform component, multiplicity aggregation, and objective weight k*q/(M*Q*p). Sample IDs fingerprint geometry, weights, probabilities, draw budget, role, seed and refresh ordinal. FrozenPatchObjective3 snapshots all robust-loss parameters; histories and linearization stamps carry that identity. Selection is one reused immutable draw; audit requires the exact selection ID and can open once per plan workspace. Evidence: exhaustive one-draw expectation versus weighted target agrees within 2e-13, probability sum within 2e-15, aggregate weights within 2e-15; disjoint roles, deterministic draws, repeat counts, refresh invalidation, posterior recomputation, audit gates and invalid configs tested. Flashalign JVM 27/27 and JS 27/27; ownership 1141 unique/64 canonical; PRD and build graph 27 nodes/94 edges; diff check clean. No MRI accuracy or runtime claim.
